privileged_info_for_vlm: The target airfoil is NACA 4412. The simulation must be run at 15 m/s wind speed and Re=1,000,000. The runaway RPM is the point where Aerodynamic Power (P) equals 0 on the Power vs RPM curve. Based on the sweep range of 50-300 RPM, the VLM should verify the reported RPM is within a tolerance of +/- 2.0 of the zero-crossing shown on the graph. The project file must be named safety_analysis.wpa.
